g.title: Respects .gitignore, then compares each file SHA-256 and mtime with the cache. Only new or changed files continue, and deleted ones are tombstoned out of both indexes. A no-op re-index takes 95 ms.
Emits whole declarations per language. Anything over 3,000 characters is split along child nodes and greedily re-merged, so every byte lands in exactly one chunk and no function is cut in half.
nomic-embed-text v1.5 quantised to INT8 and run locally through ONNX Runtime. Chunks are sorted by length and batched to limit padding, then mean-pooled into 768-dimension vectors.

An append-only log: updates write a tombstone plus new records, compaction runs only when dead records outnumber live ones, and a torn tail is repaired on load. The hand-written HNSW graph stores the log length it was built from, and a stale graph falls back to an exact scan.
Keyword index with a lenient query parser, so code-shaped queries such as foo::bar() never fail to parse.
Embedded once with the model query prefix, then sent to both rankers.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion with k=60 merges the top 20 from each ranker by rank, not score, so cosine similarity and BM25 never need calibrating against each other.
